businesses.business: electrical and infrastructure contracting and industrial products

offering_description.value: Provides electrical and mechanical design, installation and maintenance for data centers, commercial, industrial and residential buildings, plus infrastructure services and industrial products. Also makes custom power distribution equipment, heating products and engineered solutions. Sells mainly to developers, general contractors, industrial operators and homebuilders.

primary_products.value: custom-engineered electrical power distribution equipment; industrial heating products; generator enclosures and switchgear; transformers; communications and infrastructure products

primary_services.value: commercial and industrial electrical contracting; residential electrical and low-voltage installation; data center infrastructure construction; mechanical and HVAC installation; maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: data center operators, general contractors, commercial and industrial owners, homebuilders, utilities, industrial manufacturers; B2C: homeowners for residential electrical and service work

end_markets.value: data centers; commercial construction; industrial facilities; residential construction; utilities and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and cost-plus electrical and mechanical installation contracts; product sales: power distribution equipment, heating products and infrastructure products; service fees: maintenance, repair and service work
revenue_model.category: project or contract; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys materials and labor to install electrical and mechanical systems for builders, owners and developers; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates custom electrical and heating equipment from purchased components for industrial and utility customers

geography_served.value: US national: Operations across many US states, with concentrations in Texas, the Southwest, Southeast and Midwest

specialization.value: related lines: Communications, residential, commercial and industrial contracting, and infrastructure solutions segments with shared electrical expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and negotiated contracts with developers, contractors, homebuilders and industrial customers; distributors / dealers: some manufactured products sold through distributors and representatives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Electrical contractor licensing, building and electrical codes, OSHA safety rules and environmental requirements

notes: Segment mix and geographic concentrations are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
